questions: Did the party win a treasure map after a fifth player at a five-person card game was caught cheating, leaving a four-way tie?
Does the treasure map mark several locations around a town called Brandonsford?
Does Dr Uriah gamble in part to fund his scholarly work and buy dark secrets?
Is Brandonsford hailed by a member of the town's night watch as the party approaches at nightfall?
Is Brandonsford protected by a rotating group of able-bodied men on night watch rather than proper guards or law enforcement?
Are there two inns in Brandonsford, the Clumsy Fox Tavern and the Golden Egg Tavern, facing each other?
Did Sir Phidipaldi claim the sacred law of Zeus for hospitality when questioned by the night watchman?
Did Dr Uriah cast speak with aquatic animals and meet a frog named Reginald before entering town?
Did Reginald the frog warn about a trickster creature called a Clurichen that comes into town at night?
Did Dunk split off from the party to scavenge at a farm on the edge of town instead of going to the tavern?
Is Bentley, the owner of the Clumsy Fox Tavern, a jovial, talkative bald halfling whose wife and three daughters also work there?
Did Sir Phidipaldi show off his oversized lance, Lady Isaboob, to a red-headed noblewoman named Lady Hilda?
Did Lady Hilda mention rumors of a dragon and direct Sir Phidipaldi to Eric the Reeve, who has been trying to hire someone to kill it?
Did Lady Hilda offer to join the party for money if they gathered a party of adventurers?
Does Dr Uriah notice a thief named Drop Dead Ned wearing a jar with a wasp buzzing inside on a necklace?
Did Bentley offer rooms at 10 silver pieces a night and mention that his restocking shipment was a week overdue?
According to Bentley, did Sir Brandon kill the first dragon hundreds of years ago, giving the town its name?
Did Farmer Gill offer to sell Dunk his mule, named Seamus, for 100 gold?
Did Farmer Gill send his sons out to try to kill the dragon?
Did Eric the Reeve offer 1000 gold to whoever kills the dragon and drags its body into town?
Did a woodsman named George lose his arm to the dragon, which he described as a black dragon that was not big?
Did Sir Phidipaldi claim that black dragons don't exist and that sightings are illusions created by Clurichens?
Did Sir Phidipaldi slap Eric the Reeve with his glove and challenge him to a duel at dawn?
Did Drop Dead Ned offer his services, including his trained killer wasp, for 100 gold for the week plus 10% of the treasure?
Does Warwick the smith have a Mithril chain shirt on display that he always refuses to sell?
Did Bentley escort Sir Phidipaldi out of the Clumsy Fox to spend the night at the Golden Egg after the altercation with Eric the Reeve?
Does Quinn, the owner of the Golden Egg, charge 10 silver pieces for a watered-down ale, three times the price at the Clumsy Fox?
Does Quinn suspect that Bentley steals his ale stock at night, which is why the Fox Tail brew is so popular?
Did Quinn offer Sir Phidipaldi 100 gold to help him stage a fake shipment to catch Bentley?
Does Sir Phidipaldi's plate mail only count as chain mail because he cannot properly use it?
